content.title: Private pair deliberation followed by full-group decision
content.summary: Discuss privately in fixed pairs, then vote in a full-group outing decision.
content.setup: Enroll an even roster for deterministic pairs.
content.participant: Add one pair note and later one full-group ballot.
content.completion: Pair discussion ends at its deadline; organizer closes the full-group ballot and publishes counts.
content.access: Pair notes remain visible only in their original pair; the later full-group ballot does not widen that access.

provenance.credit: Constructed Harmonomicon candidate 0.19 review arrangement; not source-equivalent or product-endorsed.
provenance.rights: Original review arrangement. Participant media rights and retention are host responsibilities.
